inventory.name: AUTO DISABLED Failed host logons but success logon to AzureAD

properties.description:
The alert rule was disabled due to too many consecutive failures. Reason: This rule has been experiencing permanent errors and has been disabled. These errors indicate configuration or query issues that require manual intervention. Please review and fix the rule, then re-enable it. For troubleshooting guidance, see: https://aka.ms/AnalyticsAutoDisabledRules Identifies a list of IP addresses with a minimum number(default of 5) of failed logon attempts to remote hosts.
Uses that list to identify any successful logons to Microsoft Entra ID from these IPs within the same timeframe.
properties.displayName: AUTO DISABLED Failed host logons but success logon to AzureAD
